title: Footprints Leading Back
text: Fresh footprints in the dust, leading back toward the Gate. The boots are the size of your newest Scion's, and the stride is theirs too, down to the way the left foot drags a little. None of you has walked this way before.

options.label: The least travelled follows them, needing to know who walks in their boots.

outcomes.text: They lead to a campsite left by a House long before yours, along with whatever its people could not carry home. No one asks what became of them.
At the end of the trail waits someone wearing their face, who has been hoping they would come.

options.label: Leave them be and keep your own feet moving. Some questions answer themselves too well.

outcomes.text: For the rest of the day everyone walks a little faster, careful not to look at the ground.
